layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, tactical minimalism. Limit max-width to mobile dimensions on desktop (e.g. max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative).
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento style for dashboard metrics. Tightly packed for data correlation (gap-3 or gap-4).
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp edges or minimal rounding (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to fit the 'Performance Pro' aesthetic.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: px-4 or px-6 for screen edges. p-4 inside cards.

surface_strategy.cards: Flat background (bg-[#111111]), 1px subtle border (border-white/10). No soft shadows, use sharp solid 1px strokes.
surface_strategy.buttons: High saturation blocks (bg-[#FF3B30]). Active state shifts slightly darker.
surface_strategy.overlays: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) and 1px border-white/10.

screens.name: Onboarding / Auth
screens.layout: Full screen background image with bg-black/70 overlay. Large Bebas Neue header. High-contrast solid buttons.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.layout: Grid-based bento layout. Header with user profile and streak count (in Volt Lime). Day X/30 progress bar. Big prominent 'Start Daily Workout' card.

screens.name: Daily Workout
screens.layout: Vertical list of exercises. Each item shows a thumbnail, name, sets/reps. Sticky footer CTA 'Complete Workout'.

screens.name: Body Part Picker
screens.layout: Visual grid of selectable cards. Highlighting selected muscle group in primary color (#FF3B30) with 1px border.

screens.name: Diet Program / Calorie Calculator
screens.layout: Input form for BMR/TDEE calculation. Results presented in large bold typography. Meal plan cards below.

screens.name: AI Trainer Chat
screens.layout: Standard chat interface. Dark background. User messages in dark gray, AI in primary-tinged gray (#1A1A1A).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app UI. Use a wrapper container on desktop (max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#050505] relative shadow-2xl) to simulate a mobile app.
Make sure to load Google Font 'Bebas Neue' via Google Fonts API in the index.html or global css, and apply it to headings.

Implement the 'Performance Pro' aesthetics strictly: use 1px hard borders (border-white/10), deep black backgrounds, and punchy neon accents (Primary #FF3B30, Secondary #CCFF00). No soft shadows anywhere.
ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, cards acting as buttons) MUST have data-testid attributes for testing.
Create a bottom navigation bar for mobile to switch between Home, Workout, Diet, Chat, and Profile. It should be fixed at bottom of the max-w-md container.
For the 'Body Part Picker', use a bento-style visual grid of selectable cards, ensuring active states use the primary electric red.
Do not use default Shadcn rounded borders. Override standard radii to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` for a sharper, more aggressive fitness look.
